sections.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that the three elements of lot, Divine inspiration, and intellect found in the division of the Land of Israel correspond to parallel spiritual elements within the Jewish people and their service of G-d.

translations.translation: And the explanation of the connection of the three things
(the lot, in the soul, and in the service of man, and in the division of the land),
is that all things in the world exist within Israel.
And particularly the part of the world that belongs specifically to Israel,
as the Sages said,

"When the world was created, He divided the lands... and He chose the Land of Israel... and He chose Israel as His portion... Let Israel, who came to My portion, come and inherit the land that came to My portion,"
therefore the Holy One, blessed be He, gave all the land of Canaan to Avraham our father, to him and to his seed after him, as an eternal possession.
And from this it is understood that the things in the Land of Israel correspond to the things in Israel,
and likewise conversely, that the things in Israel correspond to the things in the Land of Israel.
And since regarding the Land of Israel,
in the conquest of the land of Canaan to make it the Land of Israel,
there were in it the three things of lot, Divine inspiration, and intellect
(which is the matter of "to the many you shall increase... and to the few you shall decrease"),
it is therefore understood that these three things exist in Israel,
meaning in the spirituality of Israel
[and also this matter of increase and decrease,
since there exists
(in the division of the Land of Israel)
regarding the body
(which is secondary),
then all the more so does it exist regarding the spiritual,
the soul,
which is the main thing].
And since the purpose of Israel is, as the Sages said,
"I was created to serve my Master,"
it is therefore understood
that all three aforementioned things also exist in the matter of "to serve my Master,"
in the service of G-d.

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: This section describes three levels in the souls of Israel—like a garden spring, a well of living waters, and flow from Lebanon—and explains how the soul's descent into the body enables an ascent to a higher level through the work of removing concealment.

translations.translation: And the concept is,
that it was explained in the maamarim of the days of redemption, 12 and 13 Tammuz,
(which these days come in continuation of the days of redemption),
that in Israel there are three levels.
As they are in the aspect of "a garden spring,"
as they are in the aspect of "a well of living waters,"
and as they come
(by means of "Ascend, O well, sing to it")
to the aspect of "and flowing from Lebanon,"
and "flowing" is a term related to "mazal" (influence),
for mazal, whose concept is above intellect and emotion, is the matter of lot, as explained in many places.
And it was explained there that "a garden spring" refers to the souls as they are above, before they descended below.
And then they are called "daughters of Jerusalem,"
for Jerusalem indicates the perfection of awe,
and as it is brought in Tosafot
that Jerusalem is named from "awe" and from "whole," and therefore we do not place a yud in Jerusalem
(between the lamed and the mem).
Therefore the souls as they are above are called "daughters of Jerusalem" because then they are in the perfection of awe.
And "well"
(of living waters)
refers to the souls as they descended below and are clothed in physical bodies,
similar to a well that is found in the depth of the earth, etc.
However, this descent is a necessary ascent,
for specifically through the service of the soul below, it is elevated to a higher level than it was before its descent.
And this is "I am black but comely, O daughters of Jerusalem,"
that the souls that descended below to be clothed in a body and an animal soul say to the souls above, which are called "daughters of Jerusalem,"
"Although I am black,
for through my descent into this lowly world, beneath which there is no lower in terms of the concealment of His light, may He be blessed,
I become in the aspect of blackness, which is the complete absence of light,
nevertheless, specifically because I am black, through this I am comely,
for I am elevated more than I was above when I was called 'daughters of Jerusalem.'"
For just as a well, through its waters passing through the veins of the earth that conceal and hide the waters, a refinement occurs in them, etc., until they become living waters,
which is a higher elevation than the aspect of a spring,
and as it is brought in the Mishnah
that specifically living waters
(unlike a spring)
purify the three severe impurities, up to the impurity of a corpse, which is the father of fathers of impurity,
so too is it regarding the soul,

that through its descent below and its clothing in a body and animal soul that conceal and hide the light of the soul, when it is revealed from the covering and concealment through the service of "the princes dug it, the nobles of the people excavated it,"
the concept of digging and excavating is the removal of the concealment and hiding of the body and animal soul that conceal and hide the light of the soul
(similar to the digging and excavating of a well, which is the removal of the earth, etc., that conceals and hides the water),
that in this service there are two matters.
One is the matter of contemplation, called "princes,"
the second is the matter of the emotions of the heart, called "nobles of the people,"
through which one comes to turn from evil and do good in actual deed,
behold, specifically through this the soul is elevated higher than it was before its descent,
becoming the aspect of "living waters"
(which is higher than the aspect of "a garden spring"),
and even to the point that specifically through this it comes to the aspect of "and flowing from Lebanon."
This is "I am black but comely,"
that specifically through "I am black" comes "I am comely."
However, the power that the soul in the body has for this service is drawn to it from its root above.
For this is the statement to the daughters of Jerusalem,
"I am black but comely, O daughters of Jerusalem,"
that the power for the soul in the body to refine the blackness, etc., and to be "comely" comes through the assistance drawn
(to the soul in the body)
from its root above, called "daughters of Jerusalem."

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that the song "Ascend, O well" was sung specifically at the end of forty years by the generation entering the Land, because the elevation of "living waters" is achieved specifically through the refinement of physical things, which is the essence of the Land of Israel.

translations.translation: And with this it is understood
that the song "Ascend, O well, sing to it" was said by Israel at the end of forty years,
even though the well was given to them from the beginning of the forty
(as brought in Rashi's commentary on the Torah),
because Israel who were in the desert,
even though they were a generation of knowledge, and as is explained at length in Kabbalah
the greatness of their elevation,
that they were souls of the World of Thought,
meaning that even while they were below they were in the aspect of the World of Thought,
nevertheless
(from this very fact)
they did not have the elevation of the aspect of "a well of living waters" and "flowing from Lebanon,"
because this elevation is achieved specifically through the refinement of physical things.
And this is why the song "Ascend, O well, sing to it" was said specifically by the generation that entered the land
(at the end of forty years,
before the entry into the land),
because the concept of the Land of Israel is specifically the matter of refining physical things, through which the aforementioned elevation is achieved,
"the land is very, very good."
And since the generation that entered the land stood with self-sacrifice and will to enter a good and broad land,
and particularly at the end of forty years, when they already had all the preparation needed for this,
and even to the point that there was already the conquest
of the land of Sichon and Og, which is the beginning of the matter of entering the Land of Israel
(not just a preparation and introduction to the entry, but also the beginning of the entry,
for the land of Sichon and Og is equivalent to the Land of Israel regarding several laws),
therefore, specifically at the end of forty years, these miracles occurred that caused Israel to say the song "Ascend, O well," etc.
